title: micromeria rupestris
intro: Micromeria rupestris, commonly known as mountain mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria rupestris include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
